title: Persuasive Visualization: NYPD Civilian Complaints
description: DSC 106 Project 2 (group). A persuasive visualization built from ProPublica's dataset of civilian complaints against NYPD officers.

title: Expository Visualization: GroceryDB
description: DSC 106 Project 1. A simple, focused chart explaining a pattern in the GroceryDB dataset of grocery store products.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This site, built from scratch with HTML, CSS and JavaScript over the DSC 106 labs, with dark mode and data-driven project pages.

title: Machine Learning for Cell Migration
description: CREATE research fellowship. Models (XGBoost, Random Forest, Ridge, MLP) that infer five biophysical motion parameters from cell trajectories, trained on 10 million simulations.

title: Spotify Music Popularity Prediction
description: Ridge regression on a 114K-track Spotify dataset with artist metadata, plus missingness and fairness analysis using permutation tests.

title: Premier League Team Performance Analysis
description: Team project. Regression models relating wage and transfer spending to team points across several Premier League seasons.
